# kion_project_enforcement (Data Source)

Use this data source to access information about Kion Project Enforcements.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "kion_project_enforcement" "example" {
  # Required
  project_id = 1

  # filter {
  #   name   = "example"
  #   regex  = false
  #   values = []
  # }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number) ID of the project to read enforcements from.

### Optional

- `filter` (Block List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--filter))

### Read-Only

- `enforcements` (Attributes List) List of project enforcement policies configured in the system. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--enforcements))
- `id` (String) Synthetic data source identifier.

<a id="nestedblock--filter"></a>
### Nested Schema for `filter`

Required:

- `name` (String) The field name whose values you wish to filter by.
- `values` (List of String) The values of the field name you specified.

Optional:

- `regex` (Boolean) Dictates if the values provided should be treated as regular expressions.
